blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The Elyucano spirit is once again taking center stage as La Union residents unite in support of Bea Millan-Windorski, the province’s bet in the 75th Miss Universe pageant on Wednesday, Nov. 25, in San Juan, Puerto Rico. Millan-Windorski traces her maternal roots to San Juan, La Union, where she spent part of her childhood surfing and paddleboarding. Her pageant journey includes winning Miss Earth Water 2024 before being crowned Miss Universe Philippines 2026. In March, she returned to the province as a judge at Mutya ti La Union 2026.
